controls.label: Thermal glow
controls.qualification: Black-body color at its measured dayside temperature, 2,996 K. The disc itself is unresolved.
controls.notes: The color of WASP-5 b's heat: a black body at the dayside brightness temperature measured in secondary eclipse at 1.22 µm (European Southern Observatory (ESO)/Max Planck Gesellschaft (MPG) 2.2m Telescope at La Silla Observatory GROND). Its star lights the day side; the night side is not measured. Reflected starlight is not included.

charts.alt: The orbits of WASP-5's planets in this map from above, to scale, with WASP-5 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

WASP-5 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (103, 105, 106) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 184240683, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 9-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
